name: Rose, the Hungry Heroine
source:
Rose is a witch who has perfected the prohibited ability to make other creatures smaller so that she might enjoy eating and/or crushing them.

What if, however, that prohibited spell had been a gift? What if she crushed or ate malevolent creatures that prey on innocent people as a way to do good? Might she turn into a heroine? Let’s investigate.

Extra information: Rose may occasionally use her powers to transform into a futa and enjoy herself with other women.

[From [url=https://tentaclesgames.com/games/rose-the-hungry-heroine/]Tentacles Games[/url]]
